copy.body:
Most "trust" work is styling. A warmer tone, a friendlier photograph, a softer word for the price.

But a stranger deciding whether to believe you is not reading your tone. They are checking whether the things you say in three different places agree with each other.

That is a systems problem, not a copy problem — and it is the reason adding more content to an inconsistent system makes the inconsistency louder rather than quieter.

The essay is in the comments.

four_questions.point: Consistency across touchpoints is what a stranger actually checks.
four_questions.audience: A founder scrolling, who has an inconsistent set of touchpoints and has not framed it that way
four_questions.outcome: They recognise the pattern in their own material
